title: Enjoy Our Universe
author: Álvaro De Rújula

edition.title: Enjoy Our Universe
edition.subtitle: You Have No Other Choice
edition.full_title: Enjoy Our Universe You Have No Other Choice

description.value: A richly illustrated book on fundamental physics, cosmology, black holes, Higgs bosons, and time travel for a wide audience. This guide for an enjoyable visit to the Universe is humorous but not a joke. It establishes clear distinctions between things we know for sure and things that we know we do not know. In this sense, it is scientifically honest.
